title: Haddock with pea and potato mash
summary: Haddock with pea and potato mash is a british dinner built around haddock fillets and frozen peas, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat haddock fillets dry and season it. Prep frozen peas and new potatoes for Haddock with pea and potato mash so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook haddock fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook frozen peas and new potatoes in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Haddock with pea and potato mash before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice haddock fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
